metadata.question: Does the surface water extent increase in the area between the Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha in March 16, 2019 compared to March 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Area between Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha, Nebraska (approximately 41.26°N, -95.94°W) - Dates: March 2018 vs March 16, 2019 - Collection: Sentinel-2 (10m resolution, good for water detection) or Landsat 8 - Since we need to compare specific dates/months, I'll use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) or a water classification 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud mask: Yes, we need to mask clouds to get accurate water extent - The question is about water extent change, not about clouds 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Valid Zero: Water extent exists but didn't increase (same or decreased) → B - Increased water extent → A - No valid pixels after processing → C2 - No images found → C1 - Invalid calculations → C3 I'll use NDWI = (NIR - SWIR) / (NIR + SWIR) where NDWI > 0.3 typically indicates water. For each period, I'll: 1. Get median NDWI image for March 2018 2. Get image or median for March 16, 2019 3. Calculate water pixels (NDWI > threshold) 4. Compare extents ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define region between Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha const omaha = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.94, 41.26]); const roi = ee.Geometry.Buffer(omaha, 15000); // 15km buffer // Function to mask clouds in Sentinel-2 function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to calculate NDWI function calcNDWI(image) { const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B11']).rename('NDWI'); return ndwi; } // Get March 2018 Sentinel-2 images const col2018 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate('2018-03-01', '2018-03-31') .map(maskClouds); const size2018 = col2018.size().getInfo(); print('March 2018 Images: ' + size2018); if (size2018 === 0) { print('No images found for March 2018.'); print('C1'); return; } // Get March 16, 2019 Sentinel-2 image const col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate('2019-03-16', '2019-03-17') .map(maskClouds); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); print('March 16, 2019 Images: ' + size2019); if (size2019 === 0) { print('No images found for March 16, 2019.'); print('C1'); return; } // Calculate median NDWI for March 2018 const ndwi2018 = col2018.map(calcNDWI).median(); const water2018 = ndwi2018.gt(0.3); const count2018 = water2018.reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9} ).get('NDWI').getInfo(); print('March 2018 Water Pixels: ' + Math.round(count2018 || 0)); // Calculate NDWI for March 16, 2019 const ndwi2019 = col2019.map(calcNDWI).median(); const water2019 = ndwi2019.gt(0.3); const count2019 = water2019.reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9} ).get('NDWI').getInfo(); print('March 2019 Water Pixels: ' + Math.round(count2019 || 0)); // Validation checks if (count2018 === null || count2018 === undefined) { print('Invalid result for 2018.'); print('C3'); return; } if (count2019 === null || count2019 === undefined) { print('Invalid result for 2019.'); print('C3'); return; } if (count2018 === 0 && count2019 === 0) { print('No valid water pixels detected in either period.'); print('C2'); return; } // Compare extents const increase = count2019 - count2018; print('Water extent change: ' + Math.round(increase) + ' pixels'); if (count2019 > count2018) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
